soal.soal: Which one is a superlative adjective?
soal.pembahasan: Biggest adalah superlative, paling besar. Big dasar, bigger comparative, bigly bukan bentuk benar.
soal.q: Which one is a superlative adjective?
soal.e: Biggest adalah superlative, paling besar. Big dasar, bigger comparative, bigly bukan bentuk benar.

soal.soal: I ... swim very well.
soal.pembahasan: Can menunjukkan kemampuan berenang. Must go kewajiban pergi, should not larangan, am not penyangkalan.
soal.q: I ... swim very well.
soal.e: Can menunjukkan kemampuan berenang. Must go kewajiban pergi, should not larangan, am not penyangkalan.

soal.soal: You ... drink water when you are thirsty.
soal.pembahasan: Should untuk saran minum air saat haus. Must not dan cannot larangan, never tidak pernah.
soal.q: You ... drink water when you are thirsty.
soal.e: Should untuk saran minum air saat haus. Must not dan cannot larangan, never tidak pernah.

soal.soal: Which word means a place to read books?
soal.pembahasan: Tempat membaca buku adalah library. Market pasar, kitchen dapur, playground tempat bermain.
soal.q: Which word means a place to read books?
soal.e: Tempat membaca buku adalah library. Market pasar, kitchen dapur, playground tempat bermain.

soal.soal: A car is ... than a bicycle.
soal.pembahasan: Mobil lebih cepat dari sepeda, jadi faster. Slow dasar, slower lebih lambat, slowest paling lambat.
soal.q: A car is ... than a bicycle.
soal.e: Mobil lebih cepat dari sepeda, jadi faster. Slow dasar, slower lebih lambat, slowest paling lambat.

soal.soal: She ... to the library yesterday.
soal.pembahasan: Yesterday lampau, jadi went. Go dan goes sekarang, going butuh to be.
soal.q: She ... to the library yesterday.
soal.e: Yesterday lampau, jadi went. Go dan goes sekarang, going butuh to be.

soal.soal: Which sentence asks permission politely?

opsi.B: May I borrow your pencil, please?

soal.pembahasan: May I borrow your pencil, please paling sopan untuk minta izin. Opsi lain memerintah atau mengusir.
soal.q: Which sentence asks permission politely?
o: May I borrow your pencil, please?
soal.e: May I borrow your pencil, please paling sopan untuk minta izin. Opsi lain memerintah atau mengusir.

soal.soal: Choose the correct comparative: The elephant is ... than the cat.
soal.pembahasan: Gajah lebih besar dari kucing, jadi bigger. Smaller berlawanan, biggest superlative butuh the, small dasar.
soal.q: Choose the correct comparative: The elephant is ... than the cat.
soal.e: Gajah lebih besar dari kucing, jadi bigger. Smaller berlawanan, biggest superlative butuh the, small dasar.

soal.soal: Read: Tugu Pahlawan is in Surabaya. It is tall and historic. Many visitors come to learn history. The text is ...
soal.pembahasan: Teks menggambarkan Tugu Pahlawan, jadi descriptive text. Bukan resep, lagu, atau dialog.
soal.q: Read: Tugu Pahlawan is in Surabaya. It is tall and historic. Many visitors come to learn history. The text is ...
soal.e: Teks menggambarkan Tugu Pahlawan, jadi descriptive text. Bukan resep, lagu, atau dialog.

soal.soal: Which suggestion is correct for a friend who is sick?

opsi.A: You should rest and drink warm water.
opsi.B: You should play football all day.
opsi.C: You should not eat at all.
opsi.D: You should stay in the rain.

soal.pembahasan: Saran untuk sakit adalah istirahat dan minum air hangat. Opsi lain memperparah sakit.
soal.q: Which suggestion is correct for a friend who is sick?
o: You should rest and drink warm water.
You should play football all day.
You should not eat at all.
You should stay in the rain.
soal.e: Saran untuk sakit adalah istirahat dan minum air hangat. Opsi lain memperparah sakit.

soal.soal: Complete: You ... borrow books in the library.
soal.pembahasan: Meminjam buku di perpustakaan boleh, jadi can. Must not dan cannot larangan, never tidak pernah.
soal.q: Complete: You ... borrow books in the library.
soal.e: Meminjam buku di perpustakaan boleh, jadi can. Must not dan cannot larangan, never tidak pernah.

soal.soal: Arrange: (1) Turn on the tap (2) Wash your hands (3) Dry your hands (4) Turn off the tap. Correct order:
soal.pembahasan: Urutan benar nyalakan keran, cuci tangan, matikan keran, keringkan tangan. Opsi lain membalik urutan.
soal.q: Arrange: (1) Turn on the tap (2) Wash your hands (3) Dry your hands (4) Turn off the tap. Correct order:
soal.e: Urutan benar nyalakan keran, cuci tangan, matikan keran, keringkan tangan. Opsi lain membalik urutan.

soal.soal: Read: Kenjeran beach is busy on Sunday. People sell fish and souvenirs. Children play on the sand. The main idea is ...

opsi.D: Kenjeran beach is busy on Sunday

soal.pembahasan: Gagasan utama di kalimat pertama, pantai Kenjeran ramai hari Minggu. Opsi lain kalimat penjelas.
soal.q: Read: Kenjeran beach is busy on Sunday. People sell fish and souvenirs. Children play on the sand. The main idea is ...
o: Kenjeran beach is busy on Sunday
soal.e: Gagasan utama di kalimat pertama, pantai Kenjeran ramai hari Minggu. Opsi lain kalimat penjelas.

soal.soal: Which sentence has a wrong verb after can?
soal.pembahasan: Can + verb dasar, jadi can sings salah. Can sing, sings, dan is singing sudah benar.
soal.q: Which sentence has a wrong verb after can?
soal.e: Can + verb dasar, jadi can sings salah. Can sing, sings, dan is singing sudah benar.

soal.soal: Two sentences: (1) Rina studied hard. (2) She got a good score. The relation is ...
soal.pembahasan: Belajar giat menjadi sebab, nilai bagus menjadi akibat. Opsi A terbalik, B dan D salah.
soal.q: Two sentences: (1) Rina studied hard. (2) She got a good score. The relation is ...
soal.e: Belajar giat menjadi sebab, nilai bagus menjadi akibat. Opsi A terbalik, B dan D salah.

soal.soal: Choose the correct superlative: Mount Bromo is one of the ... mountains in East Java.
soal.pembahasan: One of the + most famous adalah superlative. Famous dasar, more famous comparative, famously keterangan cara.
soal.q: Choose the correct superlative: Mount Bromo is one of the ... mountains in East Java.
soal.e: One of the + most famous adalah superlative. Famous dasar, more famous comparative, famously keterangan cara.

soal.soal: Read: Please do not litter in the park. Keep it clean. The notice means ...

opsi.D: Do not throw rubbish in the park

soal.pembahasan: Do not litter berarti jangan buang sampah di taman. Opsi lain berlawanan atau tidak sesuai notice.
soal.q: Read: Please do not litter in the park. Keep it clean. The notice means ...
o: Do not throw rubbish in the park
soal.e: Do not litter berarti jangan buang sampah di taman. Opsi lain berlawanan atau tidak sesuai notice.

soal.soal: Two titles: (1) How to Make a Paper Boat. (2) I Like Paper Boats. Which is better for a procedure text?

opsi.C: (1), because it shows steps how to make

soal.pembahasan: Teks prosedur butuh cara membuat, jadi judul (1) tepat. Judul (2) pengalaman pribadi, bukan prosedur.
soal.q: Two titles: (1) How to Make a Paper Boat. (2) I Like Paper Boats. Which is better for a procedure text?
o: (1), because it shows steps how to make
soal.e: Teks prosedur butuh cara membuat, jadi judul (1) tepat. Judul (2) pengalaman pribadi, bukan prosedur.

soal.soal: A student writes a descriptive text without any adjectives, only names. Evaluation:

opsi.A: Less good, because descriptive text needs adjectives to describe
opsi.C: Good, because adjectives are not important
opsi.D: Less good, because descriptive text must be a song

soal.pembahasan: Teks deskripsi butuh kata sifat untuk menggambarkan. Hanya nama tidak cukup. Opsi lain salah memahami deskripsi.
soal.q: A student writes a descriptive text without any adjectives, only names. Evaluation:
o: Less good, because descriptive text needs adjectives to describe
Good, because adjectives are not important
Less good, because descriptive text must be a song
soal.e: Teks deskripsi butuh kata sifat untuk menggambarkan. Hanya nama tidak cukup. Opsi lain salah memahami deskripsi.

soal.soal: Read the poster: Let's save water! Turn off the tap after use. Evaluation:

opsi.A: The poster asks to waste water
opsi.B: The poster asks to save water by turning off the tap
opsi.D: The poster is only a story

soal.pembahasan: Poster mengajak hemat air dengan mematikan keran. Opsi lain salah membaca ajakan poster.
soal.q: Read the poster: Let's save water! Turn off the tap after use. Evaluation:
o: The poster asks to waste water
The poster asks to save water by turning off the tap
The poster is only a story
soal.e: Poster mengajak hemat air dengan mematikan keran. Opsi lain salah membaca ajakan poster.

soal.soal: Two students: X: All long texts are good. Y: A good text is judged by content, clarity, and correct language, not length. Who is right?

opsi.D: Y is right, because length is not the measure of a good text

soal.pembahasan: Teks bagus dinilai isi, kejelasan, dan bahasa, bukan panjang. Kata all pada X terlalu mutlak.
soal.q: Two students: X: All long texts are good. Y: A good text is judged by content, clarity, and correct language, not length. Who is right?
o: Y is right, because length is not the measure of a good text
soal.e: Teks bagus dinilai isi, kejelasan, dan bahasa, bukan panjang. Kata all pada X terlalu mutlak.

soal.soal: Read: The book is thick and full of pictures. The price is cheap. Many students buy it. Conclusion:

opsi.C: The book is interesting and affordable so many students buy it

soal.pembahasan: Buku tebal, bergambar, murah, banyak dibeli menunjukkan menarik dan terjangkau. Opsi lain berlawanan dengan teks.
soal.q: Read: The book is thick and full of pictures. The price is cheap. Many students buy it. Conclusion:
o: The book is interesting and affordable so many students buy it
soal.e: Buku tebal, bergambar, murah, banyak dibeli menunjukkan menarik dan terjangkau. Opsi lain berlawanan dengan teks.

soal.soal: A student says: Because the text is in English, it must be difficult. Evaluation:

opsi.A: Less correct, because difficulty depends on vocabulary and content, not language alone
opsi.B: Correct, because English is always difficult
opsi.C: Correct, because Indonesian is always easy
opsi.D: Less correct, because text does not need content

soal.pembahasan: Sulit tidaknya teks tergantung kosakata dan isi, bukan bahasa saja. Kata always pada B dan C terlalu mutlak.
soal.q: A student says: Because the text is in English, it must be difficult. Evaluation:
o: Less correct, because difficulty depends on vocabulary and content, not language alone
Correct, because English is always difficult
Correct, because Indonesian is always easy
Less correct, because text does not need content
soal.e: Sulit tidaknya teks tergantung kosakata dan isi, bukan bahasa saja. Kata always pada B dan C terlalu mutlak.

soal.soal: Make the best opening for a speech about keeping the school clean!

opsi.B: Friends, imagine if our school is clean and comfortable every day!

soal.pembahasan: Pembuka pidato yang menarik mengajak membayangkan dan menyapa teman. Opsi lain datar, menuduh, atau negatif saja.
soal.q: Make the best opening for a speech about keeping the school clean!
o: Friends, imagine if our school is clean and comfortable every day!
soal.e: Pembuka pidato yang menarik mengajak membayangkan dan menyapa teman. Opsi lain datar, menuduh, atau negatif saja.

soal.soal: Make the best plan to make a class reading corner!

opsi.B: Buy expensive books all at once
opsi.C: Make a reading corner but forbid borrowing
opsi.D: Use a corner of the class + a shelf from a used box + a borrowing list + a picket schedule

soal.pembahasan: Rencana terbaik memakai sudut kelas, rak bekas, daftar pinjam, dan jadwal piket. Opsi lain menunggu gedung, membeli mahal, atau melarang pinjam.
soal.q: Make the best plan to make a class reading corner!
o: Buy expensive books all at once
Make a reading corner but forbid borrowing
Use a corner of the class + a shelf from a used box + a borrowing list + a picket schedule
soal.e: Rencana terbaik memakai sudut kelas, rak bekas, daftar pinjam, dan jadwal piket. Opsi lain menunggu gedung, membeli mahal, atau melarang pinjam.
